title: Channel Record
description: A place content goes: one of your websites (best-of-austin.com, better-society.org), a social account, a newsletter list, an alert feed. Records rather than config so the marketing system stays modular: add a channel and it appears as a publish target. Connector credentials NEVER live here - only a reference to the secret name.

platform.description: Where content is published: website, instagram, facebook, x, linkedin, youtube, email, rss…

handle.description: Account name, page or address on that platform.

formats.description: Content kinds it accepts and limits, e.g. ['review','photo_set'].

connector.description: How posts reach the platform. Secrets are named, never stored.

kind.description: manual (copy and paste), api, buffer, zapier, github (commit to a site repo) or webhook.

secret_ref.description: Name of the secret in your vault/.env, never the value.

posting_rules.description: House rules for this channel: tone, length limits, hashtags, what never to post.
